module_boundary: This module isolates public/private residual-insurance and NFIP backstop mechanics from general climate-insurance drag. It asks who bears losses when risk-based insurance becomes unavailable, unaffordable, underinsured, or publicly backfilled.

servicer, GSE/FHA/VA/private-guarantee, borrower, renter, and local-tax-base loss allocation
audited NFIP debt/interest, reinsurance attachment/exhaustion, mitigation backlog, Risk Rating 2.0 affordability incidence, and reauthorization terms
claim-paying resources, reinsurance, assessment rules, insurer recoupment, and taxpayer/disaster-aid interaction
post-storm stress test, reinsurance/cat-bond attachment, assessment/surcharge triggers, depopulation durability, and affordability/renter pass-through
explicit public recovery terms, mitigation conditions, clawbacks, fees, public seniority, building-code/land-use conditions, and sunset/review rules
